text.p: Delchamps Inc. said Monday its financial adviser Credit Suisse First Boston has identified a limited number of potential buyers for the supermarket operator.

Delchamps, which operates a chain of 117 supermarkets in Alabama, Florida, Louisiana and Mississippi, said a previous statement denying that it was engaged in merger talks was incorrect and issued by an employee who was not aware of the recent discussions.
Delchamps Chairman David Morrow said, however, that the Mobile, Ala.-based company has not yet reached an agreement with anyone and cautioned that there is no assurance that a deal will be completed.
Morrow said Delchamps will have no further comment until the matter is concluded.
Delchamps also has 10 discount liquor stores in Florida.
Its stock rose 75 cents to $31.50 early on Nasdaq.
